subject: engine-tests
title: Input monitor: alerts, frozen sessions and the swarm pause
note: The input-integrity monitor's toast in the real window on the iGPU: a granted lead pointing the keyboard is an alert (Allow this lead / Dismiss); a builder's refused try freezes its session (Clear / Keep frozen); a second offender pauses the swarm, said on the toast. An agent's capture never shows the note the human is typing.

images.caption: A lead points the keyboard: an alert
A builder's refused try: its session frozen
A second offender: the swarm paused
An agent's capture: the human's note withheld
